reactions.description: ThdH catalyzes regioselective chlorination of L-tryptophan at the C6 position of its indole ring during the biosynthesis of thienodolin

Tryptophan 6-halogenase ThdH, could catalyze the regioselective chlorination, as well as bromination, of tryptophan to form 6-chlorotryptophan and 6-bromotryptophan which leds to the production of thienodolin and 6-bromothienodolin, respectively.
